summary: Per-descriptor flag-byte bitfield update. Resolves the flag byte for descriptor index a1 as dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) + 4, reads the current byte, then on command a2 == 0x8000 clears bit 0x80 (v3 & 0x7F) or on command a2 == 0x4000 sets bit 0x80 (v3 | 0x80). Before storing the updated byte it captures the prior bit-0x80 state as 0 or -1 and returns a status of 0x8000 when the bit was clear or 0x8000 + 0xC000 when it was set. Any other command stores error code 22 in the TLS error slot via TLSOffsetGetter and returns -1.

local_names.v2: pointer to the descriptor flag byte at +4
local_names.v5: prior bit-0x80 state encoded as 0 or -1, then masked status

operations.description: v2 = (char*)dword_8D4920[a1 >> 5] + 36 * (a1 & 0x1F) + 4: computes the flag-byte address for descriptor index a1 inside the dword_8D4920 file/descriptor state array (36-byte stride, flag byte at +4).
v3 = *v2: reads the current flag byte before any modification.
When a2 == 0x8000 the clear path is taken: v4 = v3 & 0x7F (mask off bit 0x80).
When a2 == 0x4000 the set path is taken: v4 = v3 | 0x80 (raise bit 0x80).
v5 = -(*v2 < 0) captures the prior bit-0x80 state of the byte as 0 (clear) or -1 (set) before the write.
*v2 = v4: stores the updated flag byte back into the descriptor.
LOWORD(v5) = v5 & 0xC000: masks the prior-state indicator into the low word, so the status is 0x8000 when the bit was clear or 0x8000 + 0xC000 when it was set.
For recognized commands returns v5 + 0x8000 (status carries base 0x8000 plus the prior bit-0x80 state).
Unrecognized command falls to the error path: *(_DWORD*)TLSOffsetGetter() = 22 stores error code 22 in the TLS error slot and the function returns -1.
